units.source_excerpt: Our reasoning for the different magnitudes in the positive and negative directions is (1) that our data is all from years when the opioid crisis was in full swing, so normal in our data set is not the normal in general, and (2) that it is harder for a county to rehabilitate than to develop an opioid abuse problem, so smaller changes in the negative direction represent larger changes in the county.
